While Ben Weinman is the bassist and primary songwriter of the band, the actual lead guitarist is Mitch Lucker (who passed away in 2016) or, in the current lineup, Nick Hipa. The Planner's assumption that Weinman is the lead guitarist led to the entire search strategy being misdirected toward the wrong person, despite the fact that the user's query specifically asked for the "lead guitarist." This error occurred in the very first step of the conversation when the Planner formulated its understanding and decided on the next agent to engage.
